file_insights.changes_summary: Comprehensive modal accessibility and UX improvements
key_modifications: Added ARIA attributes (role, aria-modal, aria-labelledby, aria-label) to all three modals
Implemented keyboard focus trap functionality for Tab key navigation within modals
Replaced separate backdrop elements with integrated backdrop divs within modal structure
Added x-show and x-transition directives for smoother animations
Implemented focus management in init() with previouslyFocusedElement tracking
Added modal-dialog-centered class for centered modal positioning
Resolved merge conflict in confirm modal title rendering logic

patterns_discovered.description: Tab key handler implemented identically across all three modals to trap focus within modal boundaries, cycling between first and last focusable elements
patterns_discovered.code_location: Multiple @keydown.tab event handlers in create, bulk status, and confirm modals
patterns_discovered.reusability: Could be extracted to a shared Alpine.js component or utility function

patterns_discovered.description: Three separate $watch observers tracking modal open/close states to manage focus restoration and initial focus setting
patterns_discovered.code_location: init() function with three nearly identical watch patterns
patterns_discovered.reusability: High duplication - could use factory function to reduce code repetition

patterns_discovered.description: Backdrop moved from separate element to child of modal wrapper, sharing x-show state with parent modal
patterns_discovered.code_location: Modal backdrop divs now nested within modal container
patterns_discovered.reusability: Establishes new pattern for modal structure in this codebase

patterns_discovered.description: Consistent application of semantic HTML and ARIA attributes across modal implementations
patterns_discovered.code_location: All modals now have role, aria-modal, aria-labelledby, tabindex attributes
patterns_discovered.reusability: Sets accessibility standard for future modal implementations

gotchas_discovered.description: Git merge conflict in confirm modal between two branches with different modal title implementations. The resolution combines both approaches: isBulkOperation ternary logic merged with simple ternary fallback.
gotchas_discovered.impact: Increased complexity of modal title rendering logic
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Could simplify by extracting title logic to separate computed property in Alpine.js object

gotchas_discovered.description: Focus trap uses querySelectorAll on $el (modal element), but must exclude tabindex=-1 elements. Selector string '[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])' requires careful quoting
gotchas_discovered.impact: Escaping complexity in inline JavaScript within template
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Consider extracting to dedicated Alpine.js methods for cleaner template

gotchas_discovered.description: Focus management code is nearly identical across three modals (createModal, bulkStatusModal, confirmModal), with only modal selector changing
gotchas_discovered.impact: Maintenance burden if focus management logic needs updates
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Create reusable Alpine.js utility function accepting modal selector parameter

gotchas_discovered.description: x-transition directives assume specific animation durations (200ms enter, 150ms leave) that must align with CSS timing
gotchas_discovered.impact: Mismatch could cause UI flicker or incomplete animations
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Ensure tailwind/CSS animations match transition timings

gotchas_discovered.description: previouslyFocusedElement restoration assumes DOM elements remain valid between modal open/close cycles
gotchas_discovered.impact: Could fail if triggering element is removed or becomes disabled
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Add null checks and validity verification before restoring focus

approach_outcome.objective: Update production order modals with improved accessibility and UX patterns
key_achievements: All three modals (create order, bulk status, confirm action) updated with ARIA attributes
Keyboard navigation (Tab key focus trap) implemented consistently across all modals
Modal backdrop and dialog structure refactored for better integration
Focus management system with restoration implemented
Merge conflict resolved by combining both branch implementations
Animation transitions added with Alpine.js x-transition directives
remaining_issues: Code duplication in focus management across three modals
Inline JavaScript complexity in template markup
No apparent extraction to shared utilities or components
approach_outcome.testing_notes: Merge conflict resolution combined two different modal title implementations, increasing complexity but enabling bulk operation support

recommendations.recommendation: Extract focus management logic to reusable Alpine.js helper functions
recommendations.rationale: Three identical $watch blocks with modal selector as only variable - violates DRY principle

recommendations.recommendation: Extract focus trap Tab handler to shared utility function
recommendations.rationale: Same 19-line focus trap code duplicated across three modals
recommendations.implementation: Create createFocusTrapHandler() that returns configured event handler

recommendations.recommendation: Add visible focus indicators with CSS for keyboard navigation
recommendations.rationale: Focus trap implemented but no visual feedback for users navigating with keyboard
recommendations.implementation: Add CSS outline/ring classes to modal elements, ensure :focus-visible styling

recommendations.recommendation: Verify focus restoration handles edge cases
recommendations.rationale: Focus restoration assumes previouslyFocusedElement remains valid
recommendations.implementation: Add validation: check element.isConnected and !element.disabled before restoring focus

recommendations.recommendation: Test modal animations align with transition duration timings
recommendations.rationale: Animation timings hardcoded in x-transition directives may not match CSS
recommendations.implementation: Compare transition durations (200ms enter, 150ms leave) with actual CSS animations

recommendations.recommendation: Document modal accessibility pattern for future implementations
recommendations.rationale: Sets new standard with ARIA attributes and focus management
recommendations.implementation: Create comment block or separate accessibility guide for modal template pattern

recommendations.recommendation: Consider extracting modal title logic to computed property
recommendations.rationale: Current ternary operator nesting is complex and harder to maintain
recommendations.implementation: Add computedTitle() method to orderManager that returns title based on confirmAction and isBulkOperation
